08-13.description: Police responded to a shooting at a Garth Court home on Staten Island around 11:10 a.m. on August 13. Dana Foley, 39, died at the scene, while Dakota Suckstorff, 27, died after being taken to hospital. Police investigated a suspected murder-suicide.

08-14.title: Haiti earthquake
08-14.description: A magnitude 7.2 earthquake struck southwestern Haiti on August 14, 2021, destroying thousands of homes and damaging infrastructure. The IFRC subsequently reported 2,248 deaths and 12,763 injuries. These are later reported totals, rather than the initial rescue-period count.

08-14.title: Coal mine explosion in Cucunuba kills six miners
08-14.description: Six miners died in a methane-associated explosion at the Porvenir 1 coal mine in Cucunuba on August 14. Colombia's National Mining Agency confirmed the deaths and ordered operations suspended pending compliance with safety requirements.

08-14.title: Helicopter crash in Sehmatal, Saxony kills pilot
08-14.description: A helicopter crashed and caught fire during forestry work near Neudorf in Sehmatal on the morning of August 14. Workers pulled the 29-year-old pilot from the aircraft, but he died at the scene. Police received the report at 9:55 a.m. and opened an investigation with the aviation accident authority.

08-14.title: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake near Flores kills at least 68
08-14.description: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck near Flores at 21:58 UTC on August 14, or 5:58 a.m. local time on August 15. BNPB reported 68 identified deaths by August 17. The earthquake damaged buildings, triggered landslides and small tsunami waves, and displaced residents.

08-14.title: RSF attack on Um Arada reportedly kills at least eighteen
08-14.description: An RSF attack on Um Arada southwest of El Obeid on August 14 killed at least eighteen people and wounded seventeen, according to local-source reporting carried by Europa Press. Rights and local reports documented more than fourteen civilian deaths and displacement toward El Obeid.

08-14.title: Russian double drone strike on Sumy region kills woman and nine-year-old boy
08-14.description: Russian forces launched a double strike with jet-powered UAVs on a private home in the Buryn community of Ukraine's Sumy region early on August 14, 2026, killing a 29-year-old woman and her nine-year-old son and wounding four others, including the boy's father and grandmother who were hospitalized with severe burns. The attack caused extensive damage and sparked a fire, according to the Sumy Regional Military Administration.

08-14.title: Series of shootings in Michigan kills six including gunman
08-14.description: Five people were killed in shootings in Missaukee County on August 14, and suspect Chad Hickman, 39, was later found dead. Police found victims at two homes and in woods near Whitlock Lake; another person was critically injured. The six-death total includes the suspect.

08-14.title: Toxic gas at Sitakunda shipbreaking yard kills ten workers
08-14.description: Workers at Ferdous Steel's Sitakunda shipbreaking yard were exposed to toxic gas inside a vessel on August 14. Authorities identified hydrogen sulfide. The reported death toll rose to ten after another worker died in hospital on August 19.

08-15.title: Flash flood and landslide in Ponferrada area kill two women
08-15.description: A flash flood and debris flow struck Manzanedo de Valdueza and nearby settlements in the Ponferrada area on August 15, killing two women. Four other people, including two children, were injured. An elderly man initially missing was found unharmed.

08-15.title: Israeli forces kill 14-year-old Palestinian in Khan Younis
08-15.description: Fourteen-year-old Suhail Masoud Shalouf was shot by Israeli forces on al-Tina Street south of Khan Younis on the evening of August 15, according to WAFA. The Palestinian Red Crescent recovered his body the following day.

08-15.title: Polish tourist bus overturns on Hungarian motorway killing 12
08-15.description: A bus carrying 57 Polish passengers and two drivers overturned on Hungary's M3 motorway near Mezokeresztes at about 01:00 local time on August 16, killing 12 people. Emergency services later reported 47 injured, including 10 seriously. Police detained the driver.

08-15.title: Shooting at Lexington, Kentucky park kills one and injures four
08-15.description: A shooting during the East End Day gathering at Charles Young Park in Lexington on August 15 killed sixteen-year-old Di'Zhon Robertson and wounded four people, including children. Police responded shortly before 7 p.m. local time.

08-16.title: Landslide hits apartment in Geoje, South Korea, killing one
08-16.location: Okpo-dong, Geoje, South Gyeongsang, South Korea
08-16.description: A rain-triggered landslide struck a ground-floor apartment in Okpo-dong, Geoje, early on August 17 local time. Three people were rescued; one subsequently died. The other two survived.

08-16.title: Wildfires on Salamina kill two
08-16.description: An elderly couple died during wildfires on Salamina on August 16. Fires broke out around midday in Peristeria and Selinia, prompting evacuations, including hundreds of people taken off the island by sea.

08-17.title: Pickup-truck collision on Gwalior-Bhind highway kills eight labourers
08-17.description: A pickup carrying migrant labourers collided with a dumper truck near Chhimka in Bhind district around 01:00 local time on August 18. Eight people were killed and numerous others injured.

08-17.title: Russian drone strike on Dniprovska mine near Pavlohrad kills one worker
08-17.location: Bohdanivske, Pavlohrad district, Dnipropetrovsk region, Ukraine
08-17.description: Russian drones struck the Dniprovska mine in the Bohdanivske community of Dnipropetrovsk region on August 17, killing one employee and injuring another, according to DTEK and local reporting.

08-17.title: School shooting in Zamboanga City leaves two dead, including attacker
08-17.description: A student shot another student and then himself at Ateneo de Zamboanga University's junior high school campus in Zamboanga City on the morning of August 18 local time. Police and the university confirmed two deaths, including the attacker.

08-18.title: Israeli airstrike on cafe near Gaza Port kills six
08-18.description: An Israeli strike hit a crowded seaside cafe near Gaza City's fishing port on August 18, killing six Palestinians, including a child, according to medical and eyewitness reports.

08-18.title: Russian missile strike on Pechenihy in Kharkiv region kills ten
08-18.description: A Russian missile strike hit the centre of Pechenihy in Kharkiv region on the morning of August 18, killing ten people, Ukrainian officials said. Shops, a post office and residential buildings were damaged, and numerous people were injured.

08-19.title: Canal Hotel (UN Baghdad headquarters) bombing
08-19.description: A suicide truck bombing struck the Canal Hotel, the UN headquarters in Baghdad, on August 19, 2003. It killed 22 people, including UN special representative Sergio Vieira de Mello and other UN staff.

08-19.title: Les Issers police academy suicide bombing
08-19.description: A vehicle bombing outside the gendarmerie training school at Les Issers on August 19, 2008 struck people waiting for an entrance examination. Algeria's Interior Ministry reported 43 victims killed, comprising 42 civilians and one police officer, and 45 people injured.
sources: Amnesty International: Les Issers and Bouira bombings
AFP via La Depeche: Les Issers bombing, August 19, 2008
EFE via Listin Diario: preliminary report of 44 deaths

08-19.title: Fire in commercial building in Qinhuangdao kills eight
08-19.description: A fire broke out in a ground-floor commercial property in Haigang district, Qinhuangdao, at about 03:40 local time on August 20. Eight people were killed and three injured. The fire was extinguished and its cause was under investigation.

08-20.title: Charter plane crash in western Alaska kills all eight on board
08-20.description: A charter aircraft crashed near a remote radar facility in western Alaska on August 20, 2026, killing all eight people on board. The US Air Force confirmed there were no survivors, and rescue teams faced difficult access to the crash site.

08-24.title: Russian passenger plane bombings
08-24.description: Two passenger aircraft departing Moscow were destroyed by suicide bombings over Tula and Rostov oblasts on August 24, 2004. Russia's report to ICAO counted all 90 occupants, including the attackers, as killed. Investigators identified explosive devices detonated in flight.

08-24.title: Central Italy earthquake (Amatrice)
08-24.description: A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck central Italy at 01:36 UTC on August 24, 2016. Italy's Civil Protection Department records 299 deaths: 237 in Amatrice, 11 in Accumoli and 51 in Arquata del Tronto.
sources: Italian Civil Protection Department, August 2018 update

08-24.title: Gang attack on Kenscoff in Haiti kills at least 47
08-24.description: Armed gangs attacked Kenscoff late on August 23 local time, killing residents, burning homes and attacking a church sheltering displaced people. AP reported at least 47 deaths by August 30. The final incident-specific toll remained uncertain.

08-24.title: Montana man kills eight relatives and himself at family dinner
08-24.description: A man killed eight relatives, including four children, at a family home outside Billings on Sunday evening, August 23 local time, before dying by suicide. Police responded shortly after 18:00, and the house caught fire. Nine people died, including the attacker.

08-25.title: Rohingya clearance operations, Myanmar
08-25.description: Myanmar's military launched clearance operations against Rohingya communities in Rakhine State on August 25, 2017. MSF's refugee surveys estimated that at least 6,700 Rohingya died violently between August 25 and September 24, including at least 730 children under five. The numeric toll represents that first-month estimate.

08-26.title: Kabul airport bombing
08-26.description: An ISIS-K suicide bomber attacked crowds at Kabul airport's Abbey Gate on August 26, 2021, during evacuation operations. Thirteen US service members and around 170 Afghan civilians were killed. The subsequent US military investigation described one bomber, correcting early reports of a complex attack.

08-26.title: Ice-rock avalanche triggers Nepal-Tibet flood killing at least 1,446
08-26.location: Bhote Koshi valley, Rasuwagadhi, Nepal / Tibet border
08-26.description: An ice-rock avalanche near the Nepal-Tibet border triggered a destructive flood through the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli river corridors on August 26. Reporting by September 17 put recovered deaths at 1,403 in Nepal and 43 in China, a combined 1,446. Another 6,669 people were reported missing across both countries, separately from the death toll. Scientific analysis indicated warming likely contributed to slope instability.

08-28.title: Church minibus collision in central Zimbabwe kills 27
08-28.description: A minibus carrying church members collided head-on with a truck that was overtaking in central Zimbabwe on August 28, 2026, killing at least 27 people. Police reported the crash on Saturday, August 29, in the latest deadly road accident to hit the country.

08-28.title: Israeli strikes kill five in Gaza and three in West Bank
08-28.location: Gaza Strip and West Bank, Palestine
08-28.description: Israeli airstrikes on August 28, 2026 killed five people in Gaza and three in the West Bank city of Jenin, according to Palestinian health officials. The strikes came amid continuing Israeli military operations despite the ceasefire framework, as tensions persisted across the occupied territories.

08-28.title: Russian drone strike on ammunition warehouse near Kyiv kills 38
08-28.location: Myla, Bucha district, Kyiv region, Ukraine
08-28.description: A Russian drone strike hit an ammunition storage site in Myla on the evening of August 28, triggering explosions and fires in nearby buildings. President Zelenskyy reported 38 deaths and 20 injuries on August 30, with four people still missing. Authorities opened an inquiry into the storage arrangements.

08-29.title: Hurricane Katrina
08-29.location: US Gulf Coast, including Louisiana and Mississippi
08-29.description: Hurricane Katrina struck the northern US Gulf Coast on August 29, 2005, causing catastrophic storm surge and flooding. New Orleans suffered extensive inundation after flood-protection failures. The National Weather Service's updated assessment attributes 1,392 deaths and $125 billion in damage, in 2005 dollars, to the hurricane.

08-31.title: Israeli strikes kill at least five across the Gaza Strip
08-31.description: Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip on August 31, 2026, killed at least five people, according to Palestinian health officials. The strikes hit several parts of the enclave amid the continuing Israel-Hamas war.

09-01.title: Beslan school siege
09-01.description: Militants seized School Number One in Beslan on September 1, 2004, holding more than 1,100 people hostage. Explosions and an armed assault ended the siege on September 3. The civilian death toll was 334, including 186 children; attackers also died.
sources: European Court of Human Rights case-law note

09-01.title: US airstrike on wedding party in Hormozgan province kills five
09-01.description: A US strike hit a home hosting a wedding celebration in Kuhestak on the evening of September 1, according to Iranian authorities and AP's subsequent on-scene reporting. Five people died, including a woman who died in hospital September 3, and more than 60 were injured. Vice President JD Vance said September 3 that the US was investigating.

09-02.title: Bus crash in South Sinai, Egypt, kills at least 22
09-02.description: A bus crashed in South Sinai, Egypt, on September 2, 2026, killing at least 22 people, including ten Jordanian nationals, and injuring 28 others. The bus was travelling between the Red Sea towns of Dahab and Nuweiba when the accident occurred.

09-02.title: Minivan collision on Sege highway in Ghana kills 13
09-02.description: A collision involving two passenger minivans on the Sege section of the Accra-Aflao highway killed 13 people on September 2. Others were injured, according to Ghanaian news reports quoting emergency personnel.

09-02.title: Minneapolis apartment shooting leaves three dead, including attacker
09-02.description: A gunman killed two people at an apartment building in Minneapolis's Loring Park neighborhood on September 2 before police shot and killed him. Three civilians and three officers were injured; two of the officers suffered gunshot wounds.

09-04.title: Apalachee High School Shooting
09-04.description: A 14-year-old student opened fire at Apalachee High School near Winder, Georgia, on September 4, 2024. Two students and two teachers were killed, and nine other people were injured. The suspect was taken into custody without incident and charged with four counts of felony murder.

09-04.title: Explosion at military base in Viacha, Bolivia, kills nine
09-04.description: Explosions struck the Bolivar military regiment in Viacha on the afternoon of September 4. Authorities confirmed nine deaths by September 8, with five people still missing, and later reported 84 injured. The cause remained under investigation.

09-04.title: Fire at wedding party in Kinshasa kills at least 12
09-04.location: Lingwala, Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
09-04.description: A fire broke out during a wedding reception at the Panacee hall in Lingwala, Kinshasa, on the evening of September 4. The government's subsequent official account reported 12 deaths, lower than initial local estimates of 22. Investigators were still determining the cause.

09-04.title: Mudslide in Mingkeng village, Jiangxi, kills 13
09-04.location: Mingkeng village, Suichuan County, Jiangxi, China
09-04.description: A mudslide struck Mingkeng village in Gaoping, Suichuan County, around 04:00 local time on September 5 after prolonged rain associated with Typhoon Saudel. Thirteen people died in this mudslide. The separate countywide total of 16 included deaths in two other towns.

09-05.title: Luding earthquake (Sichuan)
09-05.description: An earthquake struck Luding County in Sichuan, China, on September 5, 2022, triggering landslides and damaging buildings and roads. The Hong Kong Red Cross reported 93 deaths, more than 400 injured and 25 missing as of September 11; later landslide research reports 424 injuries.

09-05.title: Bus crash on Fogo island, Cape Verde, kills at least 25
09-05.description: A passenger bus left a mountain road between Cha das Caldeiras and Campanas de Cima on Fogo island late on September 5, killing 25 people and injuring 14. Many victims were children and adolescents.

09-05.title: Fuel tanker explosion on Hamedan-Sanandaj highway, Iran, kills 11
09-05.description: A fuel tanker suffered an apparent brake failure, hit other vehicles and exploded on the Hamedan-Sanandaj highway in western Iran on September 5, 2026, killing 11 people and injuring seven others. The initial reported toll of 10 was later revised upward.

09-06.title: Avalanche on Mount Mizhirgi, Russia, kills 17 climbers
09-06.description: An avalanche hit a group of 33 climbers on Mount Mizhirgi in the Bezengi Gorge on September 6. Search teams recovered the final missing person on September 13, bringing the death toll to 17. Sixteen survived, including six who were hospitalized.

09-06.title: Cargo plane crash at Miami airport kills five
09-06.description: A Boeing 767-300 cargo plane operated by 21 Air for Amazon Air overshot the runway and struck vehicles while landing at Miami International Airport on September 6, 2026, killing five people and injuring five others.

09-06.title: Fireworks explosion at religious celebration in Temascalcingo, Mexico, kills 10
09-06.description: Fireworks exploded beside the Nuestra Senora de la Luz church in Santa Maria Canchesda, Temascalcingo, during a religious celebration on the night of September 5 local time. Ten people were killed and 64 injured. The cause was under investigation.

09-06.title: Hostel building collapse in New Delhi kills seven
09-06.description: A five-storey building housing a private hostel collapsed in Satya Niketan on the afternoon of September 6. The death toll reached seven by September 7, and twelve people were rescued and taken to hospital.

09-08.title: Malegaon bombings
09-08.description: Four explosions struck Malegaon on September 8, 2006, around Friday prayers. The Bombay High Court's later account records 31 deaths and 312 injuries. In April 2026, the court discharged the last four accused, leaving no accused facing trial in this case at that time.

09-08.title: Chiapas earthquake, Mexico
09-08.description: A magnitude 8.2 earthquake struck offshore Chiapas, Mexico, at 04:49 UTC on September 8, 2017, late September 7 locally. The disaster killed at least 98 people and caused extensive damage in southern Mexico.

09-08.title: Marrakesh–Safi earthquake
09-08.description: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck Morocco's High Atlas region at 22:11 UTC on September 8, 2023, 23:11 locally. Villages in Al Haouz and surrounding areas were devastated. IFRC retrospective reporting records at least 2,960 deaths and more than 5,600 injuries.

09-08.title: Helicopter crash in Sarawak, Malaysia, kills five
09-08.description: A MBB Bo 105 helicopter operated for the Flying Doctors of Malaysia crashed near Long Lellang in Sarawak, Malaysian Borneo, on September 8, 2026, killing all five people on board.

09-08.title: Landslide at forest-road work site in Shizuoka kills one worker
09-08.description: A landslide at a forest-road construction site in Kawanehoncho trapped a male worker on the morning of September 8. He was transported from the site the next day and confirmed dead.

09-09.title: Explosion at Ritom hydroelectric plant in Switzerland kills two workers
09-09.description: Two workers died after a fire and explosion at the old Ritom hydroelectric plant in Piotta, Ticino, shortly after 09:30 local time on September 9. Cantonal police described a serious workplace accident.

09-09.title: Explosion at weapons depot in Sarmada, Syria, kills 14
09-09.description: An explosion at a temporary depot for weapons and war remnants near Sarmada, Idlib, on September 9 killed 14 people and injured 11, according to the local health department's updated account.

09-09.title: Israeli strike kills family of four in northern Gaza
09-09.description: An Israeli airstrike hit the Ahmed family's home near Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza at about 01:45 local time on 10 September 2026, or late 9 September UTC. Two parents and their two daughters were killed, according to Palestinian medical and human-rights reporting.

09-09.title: Russian drone strike on shopping centre in Sumy kills two
09-09.description: A Russian drone hit the parking area of the Manufactura shopping centre in Sumy on the evening of 9 September 2026, killing two people. An initial report of three deaths was corrected. Subsequent reporting put the number injured at 23.

09-10.title: Cargo ship fire at Qingdao port kills 25
09-10.description: A fire broke out aboard a foreign-flagged cargo ship at a port in Qingdao, Shandong province, eastern China, on September 10, 2026. The death toll rose to 25 during the day as rescue and recovery operations continued aboard the vessel; authorities did not immediately announce a cause.

09-10.title: Church roof collapse in Vellore, India, kills three
09-10.location: Manju Krishnapuram, Thiruvalam, Vellore district, Tamil Nadu, India
09-10.description: The roof of the under-construction CSI Zion Hill Church at Manjukrishnapuram near Thiruvalam in Vellore district collapsed during concreting at about 16:30 local time on 10 September 2026. Three workers were killed and 14 others were injured.

09-10.title: Grenade attack on house in Dehiwala, Sri Lanka, kills two children
09-10.description: A grenade attack on a house in Dehiwala killed two brothers aged 11 and 17 and injured their father at about 03:20 local time on 11 September 2026, or late 10 September UTC. Police said the attackers appeared to have targeted the wrong house in suspected gang retaliation.

09-10.title: Tour bus crash in eastern Switzerland kills five
09-10.description: A Dutch tour bus crashed between Zernez and Susch in the Swiss canton of Graubunden at about 16:45 local time on 10 September 2026. Police reported five deaths and 40 injuries among the 44 adult passengers and driver.

09-11.title: September 11 Attacks
09-11.location: New York City, Arlington, Virginia, and Pennsylvania, United States
09-11.description: Al-Qaeda hijackers flew commercial airliners into the World Trade Center towers and the Pentagon. A fourth plane crashed in Pennsylvania after passengers fought back. 2,977 people were killed.

09-11.title: Ali Enterprises factory fire
09-11.description: A fire at the Ali Enterprises garment factory in Baldia, Karachi, on September 11, 2012, killed more than 255 workers and injured 57 according to the ILO's compensation-program reporting. The numeric toll here is a lower-bound representation of that report, not a final exact victim count.

09-11.title: Mecca crane collapse
09-11.description: A crawler crane collapsed onto Mecca's Grand Mosque during a severe storm on the late afternoon of September 11, 2015, killing 111 people and injuring 394. Manufacturer Liebherr said the crane was caught by strong winds and should have been placed in its prescribed storm configuration.
sources: Florida Building Commission, engineering review draft

09-11.title: Derna dam collapses and floods
09-11.description: Two dams above Derna failed early on September 11, 2023 after Storm Daniel's heavy rainfall, flooding the city. OCHA's November 28 reporting recorded 4,352 deaths in the wider Libyan flood disaster, with thousands separately missing. Amnesty documented neglected dam maintenance and failures in disaster preparedness.

09-12.title: Drone attacks on cars in Kramatorsk
09-12.description: Three people were killed in separate drone attacks on cars in Kramatorsk, according to local authorities. The city council reported three incidents within about 90 minutes.

09-13.title: Jakarta Stock Exchange bombing
09-13.description: A car bomb exploded in the underground car park of the Jakarta Stock Exchange on 13 September 2000, killing 15 people. Four men were subsequently convicted in connection with the attack, including two soldiers sentenced to life imprisonment in August 2001.

09-13.title: N1 minibus collision in Western Cape
09-13.location: Between Leeu Gamka and Prince Albert, Western Cape, South Africa
09-13.description: A collision involving two minibuses and an SUV killed at least 21 people, according to Western Cape officials. Three of the reported victims died after being taken to hospital.

09-16.title: Washington Navy Yard shooting
09-16.description: On the morning of September 16, 2013, contractor Aaron Alexis opened fire inside the Washington Navy Yard, killing 12 people and wounding others. Police killed him during their response, bringing the total deaths including the attacker to 13.

09-16.title: Drone strike on passenger bus in Nikopol district
09-16.description: A drone strike on a passenger bus killed five people, according to regional authorities, who attributed the attack to Russian forces.

09-16.title: Fatal flooding near Newcomb on the Navajo Nation
09-16.location: Newcomb and Two Grey Hills area, New Mexico, United States
09-16.description: Two adults and a child died in flooding on the Navajo Nation. Police said their bodies were found near the Newcomb and Two Grey Hills area following overnight flooding.

09-16.title: News helicopter crash in Chatsworth
09-16.location: Chatsworth, Los Angeles, California, United States
09-16.description: A television news helicopter crashed while covering a nearby traffic collision. Two people aboard the aircraft and one person on the ground were killed.

09-16.title: SUV and Metro bus collision in Chatsworth
09-16.location: Chatsworth, Los Angeles, California, United States
09-16.description: Two people died and six others were injured when an SUV collided with a Metro bus, according to the Los Angeles Fire Department.

09-17.title: Fatal debris from drone interception near Taif
09-17.description: Saudi civil defence said debris from an intercepted drone killed a Yemeni resident and injured two other people. Saudi authorities attributed the drone launch to Yemen's Houthis.

09-18.title: 2001 Anthrax Attacks
09-18.description: Anthrax-contaminated letters, including mail postmarked 18 September 2001, caused 22 infections and five deaths in the United States. CDC estimated that 32,000 people began preventive antibiotics. The FBI closed its investigation in 2010 after concluding Bruce Ivins was responsible. A National Research Council review found the scientific evidence linking the letter material to a particular laboratory flask less conclusive than the Justice Department had stated.

09-18.title: Bombing and gun attack on police headquarters in Kohat
09-18.description: A bombing and gun attack on a police compound killed at least 31 people, according to the victim toll reported by authorities on September 19. The attack began the previous afternoon.

09-19.title: Puebla earthquake, Mexico
09-19.location: Puebla, Morelos and Mexico City, Mexico
09-19.description: A magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck central Mexico on September 19, 2017, damaging Puebla, Morelos and Mexico City. Mexico's CENAPRED records 369 deaths. The quake occurred on the anniversary of the 1985 Mexico City earthquake.

09-19.title: Fatal strike in Jabalia
09-19.description: A strike in Jabalia killed one person, according to Palestinian medical sources. This entry records only the Jabalia death, not the larger daily Gaza toll.

09-19.title: Fatal strike in Shuja'iyya
09-19.description: A strike in Shuja'iyya killed one person, according to Palestinian medical sources. This entry excludes other deaths reported elsewhere in Gaza that day.

09-20.title: Hurricane Maria, Puerto Rico
09-20.description: Hurricane Maria made landfall in Puerto Rico on September 20, 2017, as a Category 4 hurricane with sustained winds of 155 mph. A George Washington University study estimated 2,975 excess deaths from September 2017 through February 2018 after accounting for population displacement. This is a modeled estimate, not a count of individually certified storm deaths.
sources: US National Weather Service, San Juan

09-20.title: Fatal shooting near Neve Tzuf
09-20.location: Near Neve Tzuf, occupied West Bank
09-20.description: A Palestinian gunman shot dead an Israeli man near Neve Tzuf, according to Israeli authorities. The suspect was subsequently detained.

09-20.title: Palestinian motorist killed near Ganim
09-20.location: Near Ganim, Jenin area, occupied West Bank
09-20.description: Israeli troops shot dead a Palestinian motorist. The Israeli military alleged an attempted vehicle attack; Reuters said it could not independently verify the circumstances.

09-20.title: Reported airstrike on displacement camp in Kunar
09-20.description: Afghan provincial officials said an airstrike killed three people at a camp for families displaced by an earthquake. They attributed the strike to Pakistan; Pakistan's military had not commented in the cited initial report.

09-21.title: Westgate shopping mall attack
09-21.description: Gunmen attacked Nairobi's Westgate shopping mall around midday on September 21, 2013. Al-Shabaab claimed responsibility. The Congressional Research Service records at least 67 victims killed and almost 200 wounded in the four-day siege; this toll excludes attackers.

09-21.title: Tabas Coal Mine Explosion
09-21.description: A methane explosion at the Madanjoo coal mine near Tabas, Iran, on the evening of September 21, 2024 killed 52 miners, according to later reporting. Early rescue reports gave lower recovered-body counts while other workers remained trapped.

09-26.title: MV Le Joola capsizing
09-26.description: The overloaded Senegalese ferry Le Joola capsized off The Gambia late on 26 September 2002 while traveling from Ziguinchor to Dakar. The official toll was 1,863 dead or presumed dead, and 64 people survived.

09-27.title: Mount Ontake Eruption
09-27.description: Mount Ontake erupted at 02:52 UTC on September 27, 2014, while hikers were on the mountain. The disaster left 58 confirmed dead and five missing; the missing are not included in the confirmed-death count.

09-29.title: Samoa Earthquake and Tsunami
09-29.description: A magnitude 8.1 earthquake near the Samoan Islands on September 29, 2009, generated destructive tsunami waves. NOAA records 192 deaths: 149 in Samoa, 34 in American Samoa and nine in Tonga. Runup exceeded 22 meters in Tonga.

09-30.title: Kaaj education centre bombing (Kabul)
09-30.description: A suicide bombing at the Kaaj education centre in Kabul's Dasht-e Barchi district on September 30, 2022 killed 54 people and wounded 114, according to later UN reporting. Most victims were young Hazara women and girls. A later UN report attributes a claim of responsibility to ISIL-K, although an earlier Dutch government report described the attack as unclaimed.

10-01.title: Bali bombings
10-01.description: Three suicide bombers attacked restaurants in Kuta and Jimbaran, Bali, on October 1, 2005. Twenty victims were killed and more than 100 people injured. Including the three bombers, 23 people died.

10-02.title: Beltway sniper attacks
10-02.location: Washington metropolitan area, Maryland and Virginia, United States
10-02.description: John Allen Muhammad and Lee Boyd Malvo carried out shootings across the Washington metropolitan area in October 2002. Beginning on 2 October, the regional series killed ten people and critically injured three before the suspects were captured on 24 October.

10-02.title: Kunduz hospital airstrike
10-02.description: A US AC-130 attacked MSF's Kunduz trauma hospital early on October 3, 2015, local time, or October 2 UTC. MSF confirmed at least 42 deaths: 14 staff, 24 patients and four caretakers. The US military described the strike as mistaken and administratively disciplined 16 personnel; none faced court-martial.

10-02.title: Las Vegas Route 91 Harvest festival shooting
10-02.description: A gunman fired from the Mandalay Bay hotel into the Route 91 Harvest festival crowd on the Las Vegas Strip late on October 1, 2017, October 2 UTC. The official toll is 60 victims, including two who died from their injuries in 2019 and 2020, and excludes the attacker.
sources: Federal Bureau of Investigation, incident chronology
Las Vegas Review-Journal, official revised toll

10-04.title: Hurricane Matthew in Haiti
10-04.description: Hurricane Matthew struck southwestern Haiti on October 4, 2016, as a Category 4 hurricane. The post-disaster assessment records 546 deaths in Haiti and 128 people missing. The numeric toll counts confirmed Haitian deaths, not missing people or deaths in other countries.
sources: International Labour Organization, Haiti post-disaster needs assessment
United Nations Haiti humanitarian response plan

10-07.title: US-Led Invasion of Afghanistan
10-07.description: The US-led air campaign in Afghanistan began on 7 October 2001. The Project on Defense Alternatives estimated that 1,000-1,300 civilians were killed directly by bombing between that date and 1 January 2002. The recorded figure is the lower end of that estimate for the campaign period, not a count for 7 October alone.

10-07.title: Herat earthquakes
10-07.description: A sequence of strong earthquakes struck Herat province in western Afghanistan between October 7 and 15, 2023. WHO reported 1,482 deaths and 2,100 injuries from the sequence, with widespread destruction of homes and damage to health facilities.

10-07.title: Israel-Hamas war: Gaza deaths reported in 2023
10-07.description: The war began after the Hamas-led attack on Israel on October 7, 2023, followed by Israeli military operations in Gaza. By December 31, Gaza's Health Ministry reported 21,822 Palestinians killed and 56,451 injured in Gaza. This entry counts that dated Gaza total only, not deaths in Israel, later fatalities, or a final toll of the war.

10-08.title: Kunduz mosque bombing
10-08.description: A suicide bomber attacked the Sayed Abad Shia mosque in Kunduz on October 8, 2021. A later UNAMA report recorded at least 80 people killed and at least 150 wounded. Early reports used conflicting casualty figures, including a combined dead-and-injured total above 100.

10-08.title: Israel-Hezbollah conflict in Lebanon, 2023-2024
10-08.description: Cross-border hostilities between Israel and Hezbollah began on October 8, 2023 and escalated sharply in September 2024. A ceasefire took effect on November 27. On November 29, the UN reported Lebanese authorities' nonfinal toll of around 4,000 dead and over 16,000 injured since the conflict began.

10-12.title: USS Cole bombing
10-12.description: Al-Qaeda suicide bombers rammed an explosive-laden boat into the USS Cole as it refuelled. Seventeen American sailors were killed and 39 wounded.
sources: US Naval History and Heritage Command

10-12.title: Bali bombings
10-12.description: Three bombs exploded in Kuta and Denpasar on Bali, including a large car bomb outside the Sari Club nightclub, in an attack linked to Jemaah Islamiyah. The bombings killed 202 people, mostly foreign tourists, and injured more than 200.

10-20.title: Daping coal mine gas explosion
10-20.description: A gas explosion at the Daping coal mine near Xinmi in Henan Province on October 20, 2004, killed 148 miners.

10-20.title: Typhoon Tokage
10-20.description: Typhoon Tokage crossed Japan on October 20, 2004, bringing destructive rain, floods and landslides. Official records list 95 deaths and three missing. It was the tenth typhoon to make landfall in Japan that year.
sources: Japan Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism

10-21.title: Haiti cholera outbreak confirmed
10-21.description: Haiti's National Public Health Laboratory confirmed a cholera outbreak on October 21, 2010. The epidemic spread nationwide. PAHO reported more than 820,000 cases and 9,792 deaths in the outbreak that began in October 2010 and continued into 2019; these are cumulative reported figures, not deaths on the confirmation date.

10-23.title: Niigata Chuetsu earthquake
10-23.description: The October 23, 2004, Niigata Chuetsu earthquake and subsequent activity caused 68 deaths and 4,805 injuries. JMA gives magnitude 6.8 on its scale. Some 3,175 homes were destroyed and peak evacuation exceeded 100,000 people.

10-25.title: Baghdad Justice Ministry Bombings
10-25.description: On October 25, 2009, two suicide car bombs exploded in quick succession near the Iraqi Ministry of Justice and the Baghdad Provincial Council building, killing at least 155 people and wounding more than 500. Victims included about two dozen children riding a bus near the Justice Ministry daycare. The Islamic State of Iraq, an al-Qaeda-linked group, claimed responsibility. It was Iraq's deadliest attack in more than two years.

10-25.title: Lewiston mass shooting
10-25.description: An Army reservist killed 18 people and injured 13 at a bowling alley and a bar in Lewiston, Maine, on October 25, 2023. He was found dead after a two-day search; investigators said he died by suicide. A state commission later found that local law enforcement and the Army Reserve missed opportunities to intervene before the attacks.

10-27.title: Pittsburgh synagogue shooting
10-27.description: An antisemitic gunman attacked worshippers at Pittsburgh's Tree of Life synagogue on October 27, 2018, killing 11 people from three congregations during Shabbat services. Six others, including four police officers, were wounded. It was the deadliest antisemitic attack in United States history.

10-28.title: Lion Air Flight 610 crash
10-28.description: Lion Air Flight 610, a Boeing 737 MAX 8 travelling from Jakarta to Pangkal Pinang, crashed into the Java Sea about 13 minutes after takeoff, killing all 189 aboard. It was early October 29, 2018 locally, still October 28 UTC. Investigators documented technical problems on preceding flights.

10-29.title: Mogadishu twin vehicle bombings
10-29.description: Two vehicle bombs exploded near Somalia's Education Ministry in Mogadishu on October 29, 2022. On November 1 the health minister reported 121 deaths, 333 injuries and ten people missing. Al-Shabaab claimed responsibility. An official told VOA that the second device was carried by a motorcycle pulling a trailer.

10-29.title: Seoul Halloween crowd crush (Itaewon)
10-29.description: A crowd crush in a narrow, sloping alley in Seoul's Itaewon district during Halloween celebrations on October 29, 2022 killed 159 people and injured 196. Police subsequently referred 23 officials to prosecutors over alleged failures in prevention and emergency response.

10-29.title: Valencia Flash Floods (DANA)
10-29.description: Extreme rainfall on October 29, 2024 caused flash floods in eastern Spain, especially Valencia province. By the first anniversary, 229 deaths were attributed to the disaster in Valencia and 237 across Spain. The numeric toll in this entry is Valencia's, not the nationwide total.

10-31.title: Metrojet Flight 9268 bombing
10-31.description: Metrojet Flight 9268 broke up over Egypt's Sinai Peninsula on October 31, 2015, killing all 224 people aboard the Sharm el-Sheikh-Saint Petersburg flight. Islamic State claimed responsibility. Russian authorities concluded a bomb destroyed the aircraft, and Egypt's president later acknowledged terrorism caused the crash.

10-31.title: Tezgam train fire
10-31.description: The Karachi-to-Rawalpindi Tezgam Express caught fire near Rahim Yar Khan at about 06:30 local time on October 31, 2019. Radio Pakistan reported 74 deaths that day. Later inquiry reporting identified a possible electrical short circuit followed by cylinder explosions.

11-03.title: Jajarkot earthquake
11-03.description: An earthquake struck western Nepal at 23:47 local time, 18:02 UTC, on November 3, 2023. Nepal's health ministry review records 154 deaths across Jajarkot and Rukum West, with extensive damage to homes. Research describes the earthquake as moment magnitude 5.7, corresponding to a reported local magnitude of 6.4.
sources: Nepal Ministry of Health and Population

11-05.title: Fort Hood Shooting
11-05.description: On November 5, 2009, Army psychiatrist Major Nidal Hasan opened fire at the Soldier Readiness Processing Center at Fort Hood, Texas, killing 13 people — 12 soldiers and one civilian — and wounding more than 30. Hasan, a US Army officer, was shot by responding police and survived. It was the deadliest mass shooting on a US military base; Hasan was convicted in 2013 of 13 counts of premeditated murder.

11-05.title: Sutherland Springs church shooting
11-05.description: A gunman attacked First Baptist Church in Sutherland Springs, Texas, on November 5, 2017. Authorities count 26 victims, including the unborn child of a pregnant woman who was killed, and 22 injured. The victim toll excludes the attacker.
sources: US Department of Justice, event date

11-07.title: Pétion-Ville school collapse (Collège La Promesse Évangélique)
11-07.description: The College La Promesse Evangelique school in Petion-Ville collapsed during classes on November 7, 2008. An Inter Press Service report a year later put the death toll at 97, with more than 100 people injured. Earlier reports gave lower totals while rescue and recovery work continued.
sources: IFRC: Haiti school collapse information bulletin 1
AFP via La Nacion: November 10 toll update
Inter Press Service via Global Issues: one-year retrospective

11-07.title: Typhoon Haiyan
11-07.description: Typhoon Haiyan, known locally as Yolanda, first made landfall near Guiuan in the Philippines at 20:40 UTC on November 7, 2013, or November 8 locally. Its winds and storm surges devastated central Philippine communities. Later reports put the Philippine death toll at approximately 6,300.

11-08.title: Camp Fire wildfire
11-08.description: The Camp Fire began in Butte County, California, on November 8, 2018 and devastated Paradise and nearby communities. It killed 85 people, burned 153,336 acres and destroyed 18,804 structures.

11-09.title: Amman hotel bombings
11-09.description: Three suicide bombers attacked the lobbies of the Grand Hyatt, Radisson SAS and Days Inn hotels in Amman, Jordan, killing 60 people and injuring more than 100, including victims at a wedding reception in the Radisson. Al-Qaeda in Iraq claimed responsibility for the attacks.

11-09.title: Shizong coal mine gas outburst
11-09.description: A coal and gas outburst occurred at Sizhuang coal mine in Shizong County, Yunnan, at 6:19 a.m. local time on November 10, 2011 (November 9 UTC). The official investigation recorded 43 deaths and identified illegal production and serious safety failures.

11-12.title: Beirut suicide bombings
11-12.description: Two suicide bombings struck the crowded Bourj el-Barajneh area in Beirut's southern suburbs on November 12, 2015. At least 43 people were reported killed and more than 240 wounded. Islamic State claimed responsibility.

11-12.title: Iran-Iraq earthquake
11-12.description: A magnitude 7.3 earthquake struck near the Iran-Iraq border on November 12, 2017. It killed approximately 630 people and caused severe damage, particularly around Sarpol-e Zahab in Iran. The numeric toll is approximate.

11-13.title: Paris Attacks
11-13.description: Coordinated shootings and suicide bombings struck Paris and Saint-Denis on November 13, 2015, including the Bataclan, restaurants and Stade de France. They killed 130 people in the immediate attacks and injured more than 400. France's later official toll is 132, including two survivors who subsequently died by suicide.

11-14.title: Gaza conflict — Operation Pillar of Defense
11-14.description: Israel's Operation Pillar of Defense began on November 14, 2012, with an airstrike that killed Hamas military leader Ahmed Jabari amid escalating hostilities. A UN Human Rights Council report recorded 174 Palestinian deaths during the crisis, including 107 civilians, and six Israeli deaths. A ceasefire took effect on November 21. The 180 figure combines both sides over the operation.

11-14.title: Piatra Neamț hospital fire
11-14.description: A fire broke out in the COVID-19 intensive-care unit of Piatra Neamt Emergency Hospital in Romania on November 14, 2020. Ten patients died, and officials initially reported seven people critically injured, including a doctor. Firefighters reported extinguishing the blaze in about 25 minutes.

11-15.title: Podi Coal Mine Explosion
11-15.description: A gas explosion at the Podi coal mine in Jiaocheng County, Shanxi, on November 15, 2001 killed 33 people. A subsequent investigation found that ventilation failures allowed gas to accumulate and that the mine had resumed production without the required authorization.

11-18.title: Zasyadko mine explosion
11-18.description: A methane explosion at the Zasyadko coal mine in Donetsk on November 18, 2007, killed 101 miners, including one who died later in hospital. There were 457 miners underground when the explosion occurred. Later explosions in December are not included in this toll.

11-19.title: Pike River Mine disaster
11-19.description: A methane explosion at the Pike River coal mine on the South Island of New Zealand on November 19, 2010 trapped 29 miners, all of whom were declared dead after a series of further explosions prevented rescue attempts and a subsequent fire forced the mine to be sealed. The victims' bodies were never recovered. A royal commission of inquiry found the explosion was preventable and identified systemic failures in mine management, gas monitoring, and safety culture, prompting a major overhaul of New Zealand's mining safety legislation.

11-20.title: Xinxing Coal Mine Explosion
11-20.description: A gas explosion struck the Xinxing Coal Mine in Hegang, Heilongjiang, at about 2:30 a.m. local time on November 21, 2009 (November 20 UTC), while 528 miners were underground. The subsequent government investigation recorded 108 deaths and 133 injuries and identified serious safety and regulatory failures.

11-23.title: Sadr City bombings
11-23.description: Car bombs and mortar attacks struck Baghdad's Sadr City on the afternoon of November 23, 2006. Iraq Body Count records 215 deaths in the attacks.

11-23.title: Maguindanao Massacre
11-23.description: On November 23, 2009, armed men linked to the Ampatuan clan massacred 58 people in Maguindanao, Philippines, in an attack associated with the filing of Esmael Mangudadatu's gubernatorial candidacy. The victims included 32 journalists and media workers. CPJ describes it as the deadliest single attack on the press.

11-24.title: Tazreen Fashion factory fire
11-24.description: A fire at Tazreen Fashions near Dhaka, Bangladesh, on November 24, 2012, killed 112 workers according to the ILO. Many other workers were injured. The disaster prompted a tripartite fire-safety action plan for Bangladesh's garment sector.

11-24.title: Bir al-Abed mosque attack, Egypt
11-24.location: Al-Rawda near Bir al-Abed, North Sinai, Egypt
11-24.description: Armed attackers struck al-Rawda mosque near Bir al-Abed in North Sinai during Friday prayers on November 24, 2017. Later reports put the death toll at 311. The mosque is associated with a Sufi community.
sources: Tahrir Institute for Middle East Policy

11-26.title: Mumbai attacks (26/11)
11-26.description: Ten Lashkar-e-Taiba attackers carried out coordinated attacks in Mumbai from November 26 to 29, 2008. The attacks killed 166 victims and injured 304 people. Nine attackers were killed during the operation, while Ajmal Kasab was captured alive.
sources: Bureau of Police Research and Development: Mumbai attack review
FBI: role and lessons learned in the Mumbai investigation

11-27.title: Chenjiashan coal mine gas explosion
11-27.description: A gas explosion at Chenjiashan coal mine near Tongchuan, Shaanxi, killed 166 miners. It occurred at about 07:10 on November 28, 2004, local time, November 27 UTC. Fire and toxic gases hampered rescue and recovery.

11-27.title: Dongfeng coal mine explosion
11-27.description: A coal-dust explosion at Dongfeng coal mine in Qitaihe, Heilongjiang, on November 27, 2005, killed 171 people and injured 48, according to the official investigation. The death toll included workers underground and at the surface.

11-30.title: Super Typhoon Durian and Mayon mudflows
11-30.description: Typhoon Durian, known locally as Reming, struck the Philippines on November 30, 2006. Rain triggered destructive mudflows around Mayon Volcano. The Philippine disaster agency's report records 734 deaths and separately lists 762 people missing; the recorded death toll does not add the missing.

12-01.title: Ben Yehuda Street Bombings
12-01.description: Two suicide bombers struck the Ben Yehuda pedestrian area in Jerusalem on 1 December 2001, followed by a car bomb. Eleven people were killed and more than 130 injured. Hamas claimed responsibility.

12-02.title: Haifa Bus 16 Bombing
12-02.description: A Hamas suicide bomber attacked bus 16 in Haifa on 2 December 2001, killing 15 other people and wounding about 40. The attack followed the previous night's bombings in Jerusalem.

12-02.title: San Bernardino shooting
12-02.description: Two attackers opened fire at a San Bernardino County employee gathering at the Inland Regional Center on December 2, 2015, killing 14 people and injuring 22 according to the county's retrospective. The FBI classified it as terrorism. Both attackers were killed in a later confrontation with police.

12-04.title: Lame Horse Nightclub Fire
12-04.description: A fire at the Lame Horse nightclub in Perm began early on December 5, 2009 local time, or December 4 UTC, after indoor pyrotechnics ignited ceiling material. Court reporting records 156 deaths.

12-09.title: Whakaari/White Island eruption
12-09.location: Whakaari/White Island, Bay of Plenty, New Zealand
12-09.description: Whakaari/White Island erupted in New Zealand's Bay of Plenty on December 9, 2019, while visitors and guides were on the island. Twenty-two people died and 25 were injured, most critically. Two victims' bodies were not recovered.

12-13.title: Indian Parliament Attack
12-13.description: Five gunmen attacked India's Parliament complex in New Delhi on 13 December 2001. Eight security personnel and a gardener were killed, and all five attackers were shot dead. Indian authorities attributed the attack to Pakistan-based militant groups.

12-14.title: Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting
12-14.description: On December 14, 2012, a gunman killed his mother at home and then killed 20 children and six adult staff members at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, Connecticut. There were 27 murdered victims across the two sites. The attacker also died by suicide and is not included in that victim count.

12-16.title: Super Typhoon Rai
12-16.description: Typhoon Rai, known in the Philippines as Odette, struck the country on December 16, 2021, causing destructive winds, flooding and displacement. Philippine disaster reporting recorded 405 reported deaths. Initial situation reports included fatalities still undergoing validation.

12-18.title: Jishishan earthquake
12-18.description: An earthquake struck Jishishan County in Gansu, China, at 23:59 local time, 15:59 UTC, on December 18, 2023. Chinese authorities measured surface-wave magnitude 6.2. The earthquake killed 151 people across Gansu and Qinghai and injured nearly 1,000.

12-21.title: Prague university shooting
12-21.description: A student attacked Charles University's Faculty of Arts in Prague on December 21, 2023, killing 14 people and injuring 25 before dying by suicide. Police linked him to his father's killing earlier that day and to the murders of a man and infant six days earlier. Those three earlier victims are not included in this university-attack toll.

12-23.title: Damascus twin suicide bombings
12-23.description: Two car bombs struck security-service compounds in Damascus on December 23, 2011. Syrian authorities reported 44 deaths and 166 injuries. The government blamed Islamist militants; opposition representatives denied involvement and alleged government responsibility. The casualty composition and perpetrators were disputed.

12-25.title: Luoyang Dongdu commercial building fire
12-25.description: A fire caused by welding work spread through the Dongdu commercial building in Luoyang on 25 December 2000, killing 309 people. Smoke reached a crowded dance hall; investigators said the welders left without raising the alarm.
sources: French Ministry of Ecological Transition, ARIA

12-26.title: Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami
12-26.description: The December 26, 2004, earthquake off northern Sumatra generated a devastating Indian Ocean tsunami. NOAA and UNESCO's 2024 summary records 227,899 people killed or missing and presumed dead in 15 countries, with about 1.7 million displaced.

12-27.title: Grozny government headquarters bombing
12-27.description: Suicide attackers drove explosive-laden vehicles into the Chechen government headquarters in Grozny on 27 December 2002. The reported victim toll was 83, excluding the attackers.

12-27.title: Assassination of Benazir Bhutto
12-27.description: Former Pakistani prime minister Benazir Bhutto was assassinated as she left a campaign event in Rawalpindi on December 27, 2007. The UN commission of inquiry records 24 other people killed and 91 injured in the attack, giving 25 victims including Bhutto.
sources: UN Commission of Inquiry via Refworld

12-27.title: Indonesia AirAsia Flight QZ8501 Crash
12-27.description: Indonesia AirAsia Flight QZ8501 crashed into the Java Sea on December 27, 2014 UTC, or the morning of December 28 locally, while flying from Surabaya to Singapore. All 162 aboard died. Investigators found that a recurring equipment fault and the crew's response led to loss of control and a stall.

12-29.title: Jeju Air Flight 2216 Crash
12-29.description: Jeju Air Flight 2216 from Bangkok made a gear-up landing at Muan International Airport on December 29, 2024, overran the runway and struck a concrete structure. Of 181 occupants, 179 died and two survived with serious injuries. The preliminary investigation documented bird-strike evidence but did not establish the complete cause.

12-30.title: Rizal Day bombings
12-30.description: Coordinated bombings struck five locations across Metro Manila on a national holiday, killing 22 people. The deadliest blast hit a crowded LRT train.
